question_text: A 27-year-old man is brought to the emergency department with minor injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident. He says that he is fine. He also witnessed the death of a teenage girl in the accident who was his sister’s friend. He is able to return to work within a few days. A month later, he presents being withdrawn and increasingly irritable. He says recently he has been experiencing depressed moods and higher anxiety than usual. He says that he feels guilty about the girl’s death, stating that he could have saved her if only he had acted quicker. He adds that he became extremely anxious while driving by a car accident on the freeway recently, and that, even when watching television or a movie, he feels panicked during a car crash scene. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis in this patient?
